title: Understanding National Pension System (NPS)
content: The National Pension System (NPS) is a voluntary, defined-contribution pension system in India regulated by PFRDA. It is designed to enable systematic savings during a subscriber's working life to build a retirement corpus. NPS funds are invested across market-linked asset classes: equity (E), corporate bonds (C), government securities (G), and alternative investments (A). At age 60, up to 60% of the accumulated corpus can be withdrawn tax-free, with the remaining 40% utilized to purchase an annuity for monthly pension income.
